name: frontend-dependency-contract
body: Every per-language frontend apg ships must have a solution container that declares its build-time dependencies, its scan-time dependencies, and an exact engine pin, with every code unit it references resolving in the branch graph; the bundled structural scanner must likewise have a solution container declaring its build-time dependencies, its scan-time dependencies, and that it imposes no language-version ceiling. A frontend without all three, or a code reference that does not resolve, is an incomplete contract.
